newsitem.title: UK: Capital & Regional to buy five shop centres.
newsitem.headline: Capital & Regional to buy five shop centres.

text.p: Capital and Regional Properties Plc said on Friday it plans to acquire five in-town shopping centres for 147 million pounds.
The properties will be bought from clients of Grosvenor Asset Management.
Capital & Regional said the acquisition will be financed by a proposed rights issue which would net 60.5 million stg and via bank borrowing facilities of up to 94 million stg.
The company plans to place and offer about 28.16 million shares at 215 pence each under the rights issue.
The acquisition will enhance Capital's gross asset value to 395 million stg from 248 million.
"Following the acquisition, retail properties will account for some 84 percent of the enlarged portfolio," the company said.
This acquisition, when completed, will be its largest transaction to date.
"This acquistion continues our strategy of concentrating on the retail property sector...," Martin Barber, Capital's chairman said.
